title: Antitrust and Market Power
text: The regulator challenged the acquisition because the merger would give the firm significant market power. Although the company argued that the deal would yield efficiencies, the court held that competition could be harmed. What is at issue is not only price but also control over data. Many economists take issue with the assumption that consolidation always benefits consumers.

title: Climate Adaptation and Urban Policy
text: Cities are under pressure to address climate risks while preserving economic growth. The study suggests that modest investments in renewable energy and flood mitigation can reduce emissions and improve resilience. However, policy makers often find that adaptation is subject to budget limits, legal challenges, and public concern.
